description: Ask the human for tool rights you lack, before or after a refusal: creates ONE permission question in the delegations (Einmalig / Dauerhaft / Ablehnen); several tools in one call are bundled. When answered, this session is resumed — then retry the call. A refused call ('Agent is not permitted to call X ... reason=agent_permission') already creates this question by itself; use this to ask ahead for a whole group of tools with a purpose.

tools.description: Exact tool names (as in the refusal's permission_name).

name: request_tool_permission
